conductivity.recipe: g = geodesic distance from the left seam. eps = max(1e-3, 0.05 * median(|grad g| where |grad g| > 0)). sigma starts at 1. phi starts as the unweighted Side-Neumann phi0 (production mean-value Laplacian, spsolve). For each of 2 passes: raw = |grad phi| / max(|grad g|, eps); factor = clip(raw / median(raw > 0), 0.05, 20), non-finite factor set to 1; sigma *= factor; sigma = clip(sigma / median(sigma > 0), 0.05, 20), non-finite sigma set to 1; then solve div(sigma grad phi)=0 directly with scipy.sparse.linalg.spsolve. The matrix is the positive mean-value graph Laplacian with edge weight w_ij * sigma_ij, sigma_ij = (sigma_i + sigma_j) / 2. w_ij = (tan(alpha/2)+tan(beta/2))/|e_ij| with floor 1e-10. Not cotangent. Not a diffusion iteration. No sigma <= 0.
conductivity.intent: raise conductivity where the unweighted Side-Neumann field is steep

swallow_parameters.ingest_rule: d_right > 0.5·unitW; vertices with d_right <= 2.5 are not ingested
swallow_parameters.x_rule: max phi on the column; later fronts keep phi < X; a whole front with phi > X is swallowed and X updates
swallow_parameters.empty_front: valid arc of the whole front shorter than 0.5·unitH empties the whole front

field.equation: div(sigma grad phi)=0; Dirichlet = arc length on upper and lower; Neumann on left and right seams
field.laplacian: sparse positive mean-value Laplacian, edge weight w_ij*(sigma_i+sigma_j)/2, solved by spsolve
field.dirichlet: upper and lower arc length 0→1 from the left seam to the right seam

full_height_rule: ColumnType.FULL：折线一端到 lower、另一端到 upper 的折线距离都不超过 1·unitH。其余算短列。没有配额，也不把吞噬列改写成 SHORT。

swallow.stop_reason: 2.500000（0.5·unitW） 等值线弧长 62.968076，到右边界测地严格大于步长的弧长 0.000000 短于 0.5·unitH（2.500000），F 视为空

notes: φ0 是无权重 mean-value 调和场。下边界 |φ0-s/L| 最大 0.0，上边界 0.0。左右缝内部自由顶点 96 个。

内部改为 div(σ∇φ)=0，直接 spsolve。σ 配方：g = geodesic distance from the left seam. eps = max(1e-3, 0.05 * median(|grad g| where |grad g| > 0)). sigma starts at 1. phi starts as the unweighted Side-Neumann phi0 (production mean-value Laplacian, spsolve). For each of 2 passes: raw = |grad phi| / max(|grad g|, eps); factor = clip(raw / median(raw > 0), 0.05, 20), non-finite factor set to 1; sigma *= factor; sigma = clip(sigma / median(sigma > 0), 0.05, 20), non-finite sigma set to 1; then solve div(sigma grad phi)=0 directly with scipy.sparse.linalg.spsolve. The matrix is the positive mean-value graph Laplacian with edge weight w_ij * sigma_ij, sigma_ij = (sigma_i + sigma_j) / 2. w_ij = (tan(alpha/2)+tan(beta/2))/|e_ij| with floor 1e-10. Not cotangent. Not a diffusion iteration. No sigma <= 0. 最终 σ 范围 0.05–20.0，中位数 1.0，贴在裁剪端点的顶点 82 个。加权场下边界 |φ-s/L| 最大 0.0，上边界 0.0。陡区 |∇φ| 前后比 0.9315864050712874。

没有生成 FULL / FOLD 等值线骨架，也没有在 FULL 之间开走廊。整域一次 field_swallow，步长 0.5·unitW=2.500000。第一道合格前线记下 X=该柱 φ 的最大值，之后只留 φ < X；整段 φ 都大于 X 时整段收下并更新 X。前线按整段弧长判断，过线部分短于 0.5·unitH 则整段为空。离右边界不足步长的顶点不收进源。短列和长列都保留。没有调用 extract_columns。标量是正 σ 的 div(σ∇φ)=0，不是无权重拉普拉斯。
